articles.title: Crypto isn't problem with US economy, Louisiana senator says
articles.snippet: Louisiana Senator John Kennedy largely dismissed what he called the “promotion” of cryptocurrency by the Digital Chamber CEO Cody Carbone in a Senate hearing on affordability.

articles.title: Farage Says He Can Spend Tether Billionaire’s $6.7M Gift ‘On Ferraris’ if He Wants
articles.snippet: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage called the gift from Christopher Harborne a “private matter” amid a standards investigation.
